## Must-Fix (accepted in full; plan v3 addresses it)

**The casefold sweep does not close the crash class the Goal names.** Plan v2
asserted that `re.IGNORECASE` performs full Unicode case folding and that
`.casefold()` therefore reproduces the regex's own fold. **Both claims are
false**, verified independently against the installed interpreter:

- `re` performs SIMPLE case folding + extended pairs, not full folding:
  `re.fullmatch("ss", "ß", re.I)` → False, `re.fullmatch("fi", "ﬁ", re.I)` →
  False, while `re.fullmatch("s", "ſ", re.I)` and
  `re.fullmatch("i", "İ", re.I)` → True.
- For **U+0130 İ** the folds AGREE with each other and DISAGREE with the
  regex: `"İ".lower() == "İ".casefold() == "i̇"` (2 chars), while `re` folds
  it to the single char `i`.

Consequence — measured against the unmodified module, post-casefold:

- `:16819` `"sİx same-issue follow-up rounds"` → matched, `.casefold()` →
  `"si̇x"` → `_NUMBER_WORDS.get` → None → `int("si̇x")` → **`ValueError`**.
- `:10635` `"one poİnt per seed"` → matched, `.casefold()` → `"poi̇nt"` →
  `_BEAT_WORD_TO_KIND["poi̇nt"]` → **`KeyError`**.

The driver is a bare comprehension with no per-check `except` (`:18721`), so
either raise crashes the ENTIRE verifier. A casefold-only fix would have
shipped green with the Goal's "cannot crash the whole verifier" claim FALSE at
both crash sites.

**Also: `:10635` was misclassified.** v2 called it "not currently reachable"
because the alternation `bar|point|dot|marker|line|curve` contains no `s`.
That argument is `ſ`-specific — `point` / `line` contain `i`, so `poİnt`
reaches the site TODAY (measured above).

**Resolution in v3:** keep part (i), the 26-site casefold sweep (still correct;
it closes the `ſ` / `µ` class), and ADD part (ii) — make both crash-class
consumers TOTAL (`.get` + skip-on-miss at `:10635`; resolve-then-`isdecimal`-
guarded-`int` else skip at `:16820`). v3 §3.3 argues why a site-level total
lookup is NOT the declined body scope item 3 (a driver-level `except` would
swallow arbitrary future defects into a degraded PASS; a total lookup catches
nothing and gives an unresolvable token the same disposition as a token that
never matched). §2 and §11 row 1 are rewritten with the measured
simple-vs-full fold table. The `İ` arms are added as pins at both sites.

## Outcome

The reported crash is fixed and cannot recur at either site. `re.IGNORECASE` +
`.lower()` no longer disagree in `scripts/verify_task_body.py`, and the two lookups that
could raise are now TOTAL rather than merely better-normalized.

## Key numbers

- **41 of 43** direct `.group(...).lower()` expressions converted to `.casefold()`;
  2 deliberately allowlisted and reported (`:6411`, `:12721` — verified to reach only
  user-visible display strings, neither feeding a partial lookup nor `int()`).
- **Divergence class closed by exhaustive enumeration** over all 1,114,112 codepoints,
  not by assumption: exactly **2** characters are matched by `re.I` against an ASCII
  letter yet NOT normalized to it by `.casefold()` — U+0130 `İ` and U+0131 `ı`; exactly
  **1** is lower-misses/casefold-fixes — U+017F `ſ`. `µ` U+00B5 is OUT of class (it folds
  to Greek μ, not ASCII).
- **4 new pins**, plus #2279's, all five present exactly once in the merged test file.
- Step 9c gate: **5817 passed / 12 skipped**, rc=0 over a 124-file map. Pre-push lint
  gate ran twice, both `pass`, every attribution set empty.

## What is confirmed

- **The Goal's claim now holds.** Both crash sites were reproduced raising against
  `origin/main`'s module pre-fix (`sİx` → `ValueError`, `poİnt` → `KeyError`) and are
  total post-fix.
- **`isdecimal()` is the correct guard, both directions** — independently re-measured:
  0 codepoints are isdecimal-but-not-isdigit; every `\d{1,2}` capture (single, doubled,
  mixed-script Nd: `١٢`→12, `1٢`→12, `๓๓`→33) is isdecimal-True and `int()`-parseable
  with the correct positional value.
- **The two fixes compose.** This round's AST ratchet passes against the auto-merged
  `verify_task_body.py`, so #2279's check-58 code introduced no new `.group().lower()`
  sites.

## What was falsified — including two of my own claims

- **The task body's stated mechanism was wrong.** It asserted `re.IGNORECASE` performs
  FULL Unicode case folding; it performs SIMPLE folding plus extended pairs. The two
  normalizations are different, neither containing the other, so a casefold-only fix
  would have left the "cannot crash" claim FALSE at both sites. Found in critic round 1,
  verified, and corrected in plan v3 — which is why part (ii), the total lookups, exists.
- **The body's "currently NOT reachable" reading of `:10635` was wrong.** The
  no-`s`-in-the-alternation argument is `ſ`-specific; `point` and `line` contain `i`, so
  U+0130 reaches it. That is a second crash input neither critic found.
- I over-stated the `isdigit()` risk as "reintroduces the very crash at a lower rate"; it
  is latent-only (`²` is not `\d`-matchable, so it cannot be captured). Recalibrated in
  plan v4, and a correction was sent to #2279 explicitly withdrawing that half of an
  earlier note so that session would not chase a nonexistent reproduction.
